name: post-edit-failure-releases-exclusive-grant
description: KTD-1 release-on-failure, pinned on both backends as they answer today: the session holds EXCLUSIVE on a tracked path (preflight pre-edit), then its post-edit reports the tool FAILED (success:false, no content_hash -- what the hook client sends when the tool reports failure). The grant is released without a version bump and the answer is {ok:true, released:true}. This is the baseline the targeted grant handoff (#185) starts from: a release that is not a clean success may later answer per grant, but this clean one must keep these bytes. The session claims a principal on Python (the claim is scoped, since Node answers 404) and presents it on the pre-edit and the post-edit, both require-class; Node issues none, so the harness omits the header there. The row pins the answer only: the body alone cannot tell a performed release from a skipped one.
